description: Renders native HTML table elements (<table>, <thead>, <tbody>, <tr>, <th>, <td>). Semantic table structure provides built-in screen reader support without additional ARIA attributes. Screen readers can navigate cells by row and column.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the next focusable element within or after the table
Screen readers use arrow keys to navigate between cells (virtual cursor mode)

focus.notes: Tables themselves are not focusable. Focus applies to interactive elements within table cells (links, buttons, inputs). Standard focus styling is applied to these interactive elements.

announcements: Table headers (<th>) are announced when navigating to cells in their row or column
Row and column count are announced when entering the table
Cell position (row/column) is announced during navigation
screenReader.notes: Screen readers provide rich table navigation in virtual cursor mode. Column headers should use <th scope="col"> and row headers should use <th scope="row"> for accurate announcements.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — table text uses foreground on background
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA — row borders meet 3:1 contrast ratio

consumerResponsibilities: Always include <thead> with <th> elements for column headers
Use scope="col" on column headers and scope="row" on row headers
Provide a <caption> or aria-label for the table when the purpose is not obvious from context
Do not use tables for layout — only for tabular data
